component.name: Truce Editor
component.summary: Notes and checklists that sync with Syncthing

description.p: A plain-text notes and checklist editor for folders shared with Syncthing. When devices edit the same note, it shows both versions side by side and lets you keep one. Works fully offline.

ul.li: A new editor with three modes: Visual edit shows the note as it reads, with Markdown marks only on the line you edit; Markdown edit is a plain text editor; Read shows the note locked.
Bullets, numbered items and checkboxes form lists, several per note, each with a Done section and add buttons for each kind.
Format bar: Bold, Italic, Link, Heading and Start list.
Links open on tap; on the line you edit, Ctrl+click opens them.
New setting: add buttons below lists instead of above.
The pen button opens a new note right away to type; its file name follows the first line.
A chip at the top of each note shows its place and name; tap it to move or rename the note.
Per note, checked items stay in place, go to a Done section or move to the end; card previews show "+ N done" instead of them.
A Settings screen holds where new notes go, Refresh and Keep running in tray.
Notes that aren't checklists now open rendered for reading, until you pick another view; new notes still open in Source to type.
List view: Enter moves to the next item without the keyboard closing and reopening.
List view: fast typing in an add row keeps every key.
Pull-to-refresh: the indicator stays a moment, so a refresh is easy to tell apart from an early release.
Pull-to-refresh: pushing a pull back up no longer scrolls the note at the same time.
List view: the add rows sit right above and below the items.
List view: Backspace at the start of an item joins it to the one above; Delete at the end joins the next one; on an empty item either key removes it.
Pull-to-refresh works by touch only, so trackpad scrolling no longer refreshes.
Pin and Done section are now per-device settings; only the color stays synced. After this update, pins and Done section choices reset once.
Links in rendered notes open on tap or click.
Desktop: Esc leaves a note; Ctrl+1, 2, 3 switch to Source, List, Rendered.
Refresh setting: live (where supported), periodic or manual.
Backups of the last 7 days, restorable from the home menu.
Tap the save icon to save to the folder now.
About page with version and license.
Fix: adding an item at the top of an indented list no longer nests those below.
Fix: search finds titles taken from file names.
Long list items wrap; the item menu shows on the item being edited.
Each note keeps its Done section choice.
Folders that can't be reached are retried, then shown read-only.
More fixes for notes changed elsewhere.
Edits are kept on the device first and written to the folder when you leave the note, hide the app, or after a minute.
Notes refresh when opened, when the app comes back, on Refresh or pull-down; no more polling.
Conflicts stand out on cards and have their own list.
An open note shows when another device changed it.
Lists have an "Add item at top" row.
Fix: some quick saves on Android never synced.
